name: 3-in-1 Knife Sharpener Set with Ceramic Peeler | 3-Stage Blade Restorer
description:
Upgrade your kitchen with the 3-in-1 Knife Sharpener Set, designed to restore dull knives quickly and safely. Featuring a 3-stage sharpening system—coarse grind, fine hone, and polish—it delivers razor-sharp blades in seconds. With a non-slip rubber base, ergonomic handle, and bonus ceramic peeler, it’s the ultimate tool for efficient meal prep.
Key Features
 3-stage sharpening: coarse, fine, polish
 Diamond-coated surfaces for precision sharpening
 Ergonomic non-slip handle for safe use
 Works for both left & right-handed users
 Bonus ceramic knife peeler included
 Compact, durable, and kitchen-friendly design
Ingredients / Materials
Diamond-coated sharpening slots, ABS plastic body, rubber base, ceramic peeler
How to Use
 Place sharpener on a flat surface with non-slip base secured
 Insert knife into coarse slot to restore dull blades
 Use fine slot for sharpening and polishing slot for finishing edge
 Wash knife after sharpening before use
 Use ceramic peeler for fruits, vegetables, or meat
Package Includes
 1 × 3-in-1 Knife Sharpener
 1 × Ceramic Peeler
